text: Yeah, that all sounds fine. The price difference is okay, I'll just pay the extra $17.86 on my Mastercard ending in 1276. And the address will be updated to my default Chicago one. So, yes, please go ahead and modify the order.
zh: 是的，都听起来很好。价格差异可以，我会在我的以1276结尾的Mastercard上支付额外的$17.86。地址会更新到我的默认芝加哥地址。所以，是的，请继续修改订单。
